name: palimpsest
description: Behavior-neutral three-agent runner for the Palimpsest distributed decipherment puzzle.

scripts.format: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts packages tools tests specs docs AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts packages tools tests specs docs AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml --check python
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages tools tests vitest.config.ts && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff check --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:versions && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:py && pnpm contracts:compare
